annotations.title: Lookup Grant Credit Pools & Workhorse Model Tiers

description: Lists catalog credit grant programs (Google Cloud Tier 1, AWS Activate Bedrock) and low-cost workhorse candidates benchmarked against a baseline model ID. Deterministic local snapshot lookup that issues zero external account probes, requires no API keys, and consumes zero user quota. Returns JSON with baseline_model_rate_card, detected_credit_pools, and interactive_perks_url. Use this tool to inspect grant tiers and workhorse options before calling auto_route_task_by_quality_tier; use list_supported_models instead when searching or filtering all 452+ model rate cards by provider.

current_model.description: Active primary model ID in 'vendor/model-slug' format used as the baseline cost reference.
